U_0x00E4FA: Flagship of the Gaia Sabers, built by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Multiple <Tesla Drive>s let the all-purpose carrier operate in space, air, and on or under water. Faster than the Space Noah class and carrying more humanoid weapons, it stows bridge and guns for a high-speed cruise form. Its 'Break Field' (a T-Dot Array force field) and bow 'Field Blade' let it break lines, storm fortresses, and duel warships. Further special features remain unknown.
U_0x00E871: Aerial combat carrier used by the <Earth Fed Army> and others. Fighters and <Armored Module>s launch and land in flight; air defenses and armament make it a flying fortress.
U_0x00E9BA: A large strategic transport plane of the <Earth Fed Army>. It carries up to five <Personal Trooper>s to the front, and its launch catapult lets <Personal Trooper>s sortie in flight for rapid deployment.
U_0x00EB56: First of the 'Dynamic General Guardian' series ('Double G'), humanoid weapons designed by Dr. Bian Zoldark, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>), to defend the <Earth Cradle>. A sword and melee unit, its 'DML System' and dedicated OS 'JINKI-1' unite pilot and machine. Its 'ABMD (artificial musculoskeletal drive) System' yields far more supple, dynamic motion than same-size humanoid weapons.
U_0x00EE6C: Second 'Double G' of the 'Dynamic General Guardian' series designed by Bian Zoldark, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>). To suit Ratsel's hit-and-run style it mounts a long-barreled beam cannon, high-output verniers, and wheels (Ferse Rad) for fast ground travel. It can shift to Pferd Mode and bear DyGenGuard on its back; the pair resemble a mounted warrior.
U_0x00F170: Third Dynamic General Guardian, built by Dr. Kaoru Toumine from Bian Zoldark's blueprints. A pilotless high-speed melee unit run by the AI 'System ZLAI,' made to destroy DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter. Ninja-themed, it wields shuriken (Multiply Blades) and a ninja sword (Anchor Secrate Sword). An improved 'ABMD (artificial musculoskeletal drive) System' makes it nimbler than both, with EA (electronic attack) and EP (electronic defense) functions.
